text:
sara-people: Heads up — offer accepted for UK-based hire (Lina Gomez) but she was accidentally created in Payroll as a US contractor. Need to stop/recall payments and reclassify as UK employee before any W-2s are finalized. Details below.

payroll-bot: Payroll record created: PR-2026-045 for Lina Gomez (entity: RWI-US, contractor flag = true) — initial payment scheduled/paid 2026-03-15.

tom-payroll: On it. Pulling her record now. Which legal entity and start date?

sara-people: RWI-US, start_date: 2026-03-01, onboarding form shows UK address and UK bank details but PM selected Contractor - US in Workday. First pro-rated salary paid 2026-03-15.

jamal-tax: Important — if she should have been a UK employee we must not have a W-2 for UK employment. Options: (1) recover the contractor payment and run UK PAYE retroactively, (2) if recovery impossible, we may need to file W-2c and coordinate with UK payroll for tax credits. Also check National Insurance and employer NI liabilities.

alex-ops: Proposed checklist: 1) Immediately pause any upcoming contractor payments; 2) Open a payment reversal ticket with payments ops; 3) Create UK payroll record and provision PAYE; 4) Prepare employee consent for sharing pay details; 5) If a W-2 is generated, prepare correction steps. I can start tickets.

tom-payroll: I see a payout: StripePayout ID SP-7788 for $3,200 on 2026-03-15. If that went to contractor flow, might be vendor payout. I'll flag payments team and put a stop on any future recurring contractor payments.

maria-hr: @tom-payroll can you pause contractor recurring payments and tag this as "UK-reclass"? I'll reach out to Lina for confirmation and consent to transfer records to our UK payroll provider.

legal: No immigration/work-authorization issue. From a documentation POV we need offer and signed contract showing UK employment. For reporting, we'll need to coordinate US side to void/recall any US payroll reporting.

jamal-tax: Timeline note — year-end W-2 run is in November. Target to have reclassification and corrected reporting well before Oct 15 to avoid year-end churn. I'll lead the tax-side remediation with @legal.

global-payroll-bot: Assigned to global payroll queue: GP-2026-78 (task: provision UK record + PAYE set up).

oliver-gp: I have GP-2026-78. Next steps I need: confirmed bank details (IBAN), right-to-work docs, employee consent to accept previous payment data. Once we have consent I can provision PAYE from 2026-03-01 and run an adjustment.

sara-people: I'll DM Lina now and request the consent form. Also attaching screenshots showing onboarding selection error and the Workday audit trail.

tom-payroll: Opening reversal ticket PAY-REV-312: asked payments ops to attempt retrieval from SP-7788. If funds cannot be pulled back, we need authorization from finance to treat as gross-up/adjustment on UK payroll or seek reimbursement.

jamal-tax: If funds are unrecoverable, document everything and we can apply for a payroll correction approach: issue W-2c if any US reporting occurred, and report the amounts to HMRC via PAYE as taxable earnings with employer/NIC adjustments. Will need employee sign-off for retro PAYE.

maria-hr: Lina replied: "I confirmed I accepted UK employment, bank details attached, I consent to share the payout info and to retro PAYE setup." I'll upload consent form to the case.

oliver-gp: Received consent. I'll kick off PAYE provisioning and run a provisional payroll adjustment. Expect follow-up questions on pension auto-enrolment and employer NI.

tom-payroll: I'll keep PAY-REV-312 updated. Pls add any invoices or vendor records that show Lina as vendor — ping me directly.

legal: We'll prepare an explanatory letter for Lina and a reconciliation note for the finance audit trail. Also drafting wording for the W-2/W-2c explanation to be shared internally.

jamal-tax: Target milestone: reclassification completed and UK payroll live by 2026-10-10; corrected filings (if any) submitted before year-end. I'll own tax filings, @legal will own documentation, @tom-payroll owns payout reversal.

sara-people: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated as tickets progress. If anyone sees additional payments to SP-7788, @tom-payroll please escalate. :thumbsup:

payroll-bot: Ticket updates: PR-2026-045 -> status: under review, linked: PAY-REV-312, GP-2026-78."
